Betikler ve dış sistemler panel girişi o: Scripts and other systems use these tokens to call the {path} endpoints without signing in to the panel.
Jeton yalnızca oluşturulurken bir kez gö: A token is shown once, when it is created; the server keeps only its hash. Read-only tokens can only read; Admin tokens do day-to-day work but can't use superadmin actions, users, tokens or remote screen.
Harf, rakam, boşluk, nokta, alt çizgi ya: Letters, digits, spaces, dots, underscores or hyphens; up to 64 characters.
Jetonla yapılan işler kayıtlara {name} o: Actions done with the token are logged as {name}. Names are unique.
Günlük işleri yapar (görev, sınıf, karan: Does day-to-day work (tasks, labs, quarantine). Superadmin actions, users, tokens and remote screen are off.
1 ile 3650 arasında bir sayı girin ya da: Enter a number from 1 to 3650, or leave it empty.
Jeton bir daha gösterilmez; şimdi kopyal: The token won't be shown again; copy it now and keep it somewhere safe. Send it to the /api/v1 endpoints in an Authorization: Bearer <token> header.
Bu jetonu kullanan betikler hemen erişim: Scripts that use this token lose access at once. This can't be undone; the token stays in the list as revoked.
